exposure: single intrauterine fetal death (sIUFD) in twin pregnancies
outcome: perinatal morbidity (neurological damage, complications of preterm birth)
need for neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 53 twin pregnancies complicated by single intrauterine fetal death (sIUFD) followed up in a perinatology department.
finding: Birth of the live fetus in monochorionic (MC) twin pregnancies occurred significantly earlier and was associated with higher mortality and morbidity compared to dichorionic (DC) twin pregnancies after sIUFD.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth for the surviving twin was 30 weeks in monochorionic pregnancies and 34 weeks in dichorionic pregnancies; deliveries before 37 weeks occurred in 79.3% of MC and 62.5% of DC pregnancies, and before 34 weeks in 65.5% of MC and 33.3% of DC pregnancies.
